title: Glass Court
hook: Let an awkward ball rebound behind you, dash into position and turn a last-second return into a multiplier-building bank shot.
audience: Players of short arcade score attacks and expressive ball-control games.
core_loop: Serve; move and time returns through glowing wall targets; recover increasingly awkward rebounds; miss ends the chain; retry a 60–120-second rally or another challenge.
score_notes: See action-trends.md. Commercial confidence is low; build estimate remains conditional on day-one ball feel.

inspiration.connection: Borrow padel's playable back-wall recovery and glass-court identity for an arcade game; realistic sport simulation is not required.
inspiration.evergreen_promise: Learning timing, angles and recovery should reward mastery even after the real sport's growth slows.
inspiration.current_timing: Historical source growth or current expansion is recorded separately; September search slope and future peak are unverified.

commercial_hypothesis.condition: Genre/price evidence and a worthwhile finished experience within the work budget are both required. These are test prices, not selected prices or sales forecasts.

prototype_envelope.scope: One-day greybox, three fresh players for ten minutes each. Hold if two cannot explain misses as position versus swing timing or two do not want another run. Require a ten-second capture to communicate bank-and-recover rather than generic ball bouncing.

production_envelope.scope: One top-down/oblique 2D court, one ball, six authored challenge patterns, arcade trajectories, local medals and records.
production_envelope.note: Includes prototype, original modest art/audio, finite content, controls/settings/save, packaged Windows QA and draft store media. Calendar onboarding/review, recruitment and unforeseen rework are separate. Estimate is not demonstrated.

cash_assumptions.note: Existing tools assumed. No purchases or cash allocation. Steam fee and optional assets remain separate planning inputs in the run.

support_estimate: Allow 1–2 owner hours for launch-month triage/review, plus agent fixes as needed; actual burden unknown.

evidence.claim: December 2, 2025 FIP release reports global clubs +16.1% and courts +15.2% in the 2025 federation survey. Exact common census cutoff incomplete.
June 23, 2026 FIP release reports 38 million players, 85,000 courts and 27,000 clubs globally. These annual summaries do not establish September acceleration.
10S FOREVER: USD 7.99 regular/current, 94 Steam-purchase reviews, 98.9% positive. Eight stages, bosses and local co-op exceed our scope.
Antonball Deluxe: USD 4.99 regular/current, 775 reviews, 95.7% positive. Three modes and 69 levels make the value comparison demanding.
Hyper Paddle: USD 2.99 regular/current, one review, despite advertising 50 levels and a control twist. Low visible response is not a measured sales total.
Developer sells 10S FOREVER on itch.io as well as Steam. A second storefront, not an independent sales disclosure.

risks: 10S FOREVER and Antonball Deluxe offer substantially more content at low prices.
A tiny rally challenge could feel like a free minigame.
Participation growth does not establish interest in a PC sports game.
No primary paid-unit disclosure found for the close ball-control comparators.
evidence_limits: Desk research only. No own playable build, competitor hands-on test, measured organic conversion, target-player willingness to pay or validated production time. Current names are working titles without clearance.
next_test: One-day greybox, three fresh players for ten minutes each. Hold if two cannot explain misses as position versus swing timing or two do not want another run. Require a ten-second capture to communicate bank-and-recover rather than generic ball bouncing.
decision_reason: Shortlisted as the cheapest focused active-skill alternative; historical sport growth is better supported than demand for our exact small product.

decision_history.reason: Shortlisted as the cheapest focused active-skill alternative; historical sport growth is better supported than demand for our exact small product. Research only; no game selected.
